steps.text: Open https://site.ludus-game.com/store/?user-id={TEST_USER_ID} in the browser and wait until the page has finished loading.

steps.text: If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss". If a "Login successful" popup is shown, click "Ok".
steps.saw: Cookie banner dismissed; no Login successful popup

steps.text: Does the header show the green "Player{TEST_USER_ID}" button, and no "Login" button?
steps.saw: Green Player{TEST_USER_ID} button with balances 40 and 0, no Login button
Scrolled to the Store heading (ribbon) with the tab bar below

steps.text: Does the tab bar show only "Free wares", "Might Passes" and "Gold"?
steps.saw: Store tab bar has exactly Free wares, Might Passes, Gold

steps.text: Is the "Special offers" section with "Small welcome bundle", "Medium welcome bundle" and "Big welcome bundle" shown?
steps.saw: Special offers section shown; carousel (3 slides) shows Small welcome bundle (USD price not touched), Medium and Big welcome bundle are in the other slides

steps.text: Is the "Log in to see more offers" button gone?
